appearance: Three translucent layers: a smaller clearer flame core, middle smoke and slightly wider faint outer smoke. All 64 original Yakuza 6 e_f_0014_roop_smoke01 frames are reused unchanged. Each sprite varies its source animation phase, speed, size and tight swirl; every attack receives a fresh cosmetic seed. Kiwami 2 wisps/fan now supply randomized small confirmed-impact puffs, plus six smaller curved flying sparks. Their original pixels and matching colours are unchanged. Smoke history lasts at most 70 ms and is tethered to within two base-scale screen pixels of the current limb before bounded swirl. Impact puffs shrink from scale .28 to .11; spark scale becomes .055..09; lives shrink to 150..210 ms. The pre-existing heavy shock ring is also smaller and fainter.
tracking: 120 Hz baked native limb FK with current animation clock/facing and actor position. Cached fading copies are rechecked so incoming source time is retained; same-clip duplicate resolution chooses the incoming track. Baked coating is suppressed below 70% attack track weight and smoothly fades in above that weight. Missing native tracks cannot display stale coating; outgoing smoke reanchors to the current source pose and disappears when that pose blends out. This reduces blending mismatch without reading the final engine-blended skeleton or adding a Java bridge. Existing QTE confirmation gating and hit presentation remain intact.
